en.lens.name: Polished lens
en.lens.description: A clear glass lens in a silver mounting. It catches the gallery light. Keep it safe; someone may be looking for it.
en.key.name: Brass key
en.key.description: A small brass key stamped with a gate bolt. It opens the Gallery Storeroom door and stays on your keyring.
en.ledger.name: Archive ledger
en.ledger.description: A bound record from the Gallery Storeroom. The archive clerk asked for it.
en.workshop-key.name: Workshop key
en.workshop-key.description: A small iron key for the Workshop's west supply-room door. It stays on your keyring.
